english.note: This is the all-purpose verb for doing something despite a known danger.
This is the all-purpose choice for risking something or venturing to do something.

examples.english: Going swimming in such heavy rain is really a risk.
examples.traditional: 落咁大雨仲去游水，真係冒險喎。
examples.jyutping: lok6 gam3 daai6 jyu5 zung6 heoi3 jau4 seoi2 zan1 hai6 mou6 him2 wo3

examples.english: I wouldn't hazard taking something this expensive through customs.
examples.traditional: 我唔會冒險帶咁貴嘅嘢過關。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 m4 wui5 mou6 him2 daai3 gam3 gwai3 ge3 je5 gwo3 gwaan1
